name: Oil supply shock (Brent +30%)
rationale: A supply disruption (e.g. Strait of Hormuz) lifts Brent in EUR by 30% and it stays there. Fuel consumer prices respond with the estimated elasticity 0.31 (HAC s.e. 0.04, 2005-03–2026-09): +8.4% on the fuel price level, 66% of it in the first month. Elasticity < 1 because excise duty is per litre.
mapping: FUEL level = (1.30)^0.307 − 1, lag profile from the estimated distributed lag
